`LICENSE.txt` is copied unchanged from pyserial **v3.5**:
https://github.com/pyserial/pyserial/blob/v3.5/LICENSE.txt

The published 3.5 wheel omits this file, so the release build copies the checked-in
upstream license into `notices/PYSERIAL-LICENSE.txt`. Refresh it when changing the
pinned pyserial build dependency.
